neighbours.label: ' you' as the subject right after an introductory clause and comma (When X happens, you ...), where a modal like may/might/will comes next; generic second-person statements about what a reader will experience
fire: When the nurse inserts the needle into your vein, you may feel a brief pinch and some mild pressure on the skin.
If the battery is nearly dead when you boot the laptop, you might see random shutdowns and flickering screens during startup.
After you have trained consistently for several weeks, you will notice that your stamina improves and your recovery time shrinks.
As the infection spreads through the lungs, you may find that even short walks leave you short of breath.
Whenever you open the old project in the new editor, you may experience odd formatting errors across many files.
Once the paint has fully dried on the walls, you will see small cracks appear near the window frames.
If you keep adding too many plugins to the browser, you might find that pages load far more slowly than before.
By the time the hike reaches the ridge, you may notice thinner air and a sharp drop in temperature.
quiet: The nurse inserted the needle into the vein and the patient barely flinched during the whole short procedure.
Our laptop shut down randomly last week, and the repair shop said the battery was almost completely dead.
Consistent training over several weeks improved his stamina, and his recovery time shrank noticeably by the end of spring.
The infection spread through the lungs quickly, and doctors reported that even short walks left the patient breathless.
Thank you for opening the project; we are glad that formatting errors across the old files are finally fixed.
The paint dried on the walls overnight, but small cracks appeared near the window frames by morning.
I told them you were coming to the party, and they said the kitchen would be ready by then.
The hike reached the ridge at noon, where the air was thinner and the temperature dropped sharply.

notes: Label and sentences written blind by a Claude subagent from the card text alone (prompt: haiku_labeler/prompt.md, identical for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus); one retry on mechanical checks. Part of a Haiku/Sonnet/Opus comparison on the same 48 poles.
